rationale: The agent executed exchanges without authenticating the user, did not verify ownership or delivery status of the orders/items, and performed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without seeking user confirmation. This violates the requirement to authenticate and confirm before any write. The agent also charged a price difference to PayPal without explicit confirmation and provided a specific charge amount unsupported by visible tool results. Therefore, the interaction fails the policy-aligned pass bar.
